about: I'm an open source enthusiast and a veteran Linux user who loves experimenting with immutable and atomic operating systems. I have experience building distributed systems, web services and event-driven systems, along with a deep understanding of system internals.
My passion for technology drives me to keep learning and improving, as you can see on my GitHub.

experience.title: Sr. Systems Development Engineer
highlights: Grew the stuck-shipment platform I designed in 2023 into a proactive shipment issue detection system I still own, integrated with two partner teams for two critical workflows, unblocking ~10M shipments/week and saving ~$100M annually.

Led and mentored 6 engineers to bootstrap ~20 critical Amazon Fulfillment Network services in a new region, meeting deadlines and unblocking its launch; authored service-agnostic runbooks so the team needed minimal support from owning teams.

Grew the emergency recovery tool I created in 2023 from a single use case into the worldwide standard recovery platform for all Amazon warehouses, automating key steps of warehouse recovery after large-scale events (fire, flood, etc.) and saving ~8 weeks of labour per incident across 6+ incidents/year.
Provide high severity support for critical services, documenting and preparing communications to senior leadership.

Partnered with a Principal Engineer to reproduce the failure behind a prolonged, multi-million-dollar Sev1 outage, enabling its diagnosis and a permanent fix by the owning team with no recurrence since.
Building an AI-driven test automation platform that uses coverage metrics and API models to generate tests, targeting a 20% increase in test coverage across the organization.

experience.title: Systems Development Engineer
highlights: Designed and built a safe inventory deletion system for emergencies in Amazon Warehouses saving ~4000 hours of labour every year summing up to $5M/yr.
Led architecture design and execution, mentoring junior engineers through implementation and delivery of a platform processing 5k requests/week.
Implemented technically involved parts of ongoing projects (authentication, database access, performance-related functionality).

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
highlights: Created the first version of a web-based emergency recovery tool. It automated a clunky and error-prone manual process which resulted in savings of ~1500 engineer hours per year. (AWS API Gateway, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS)
Architected the back-end application on AWS Lambda to lower ongoing maintenance costs. (Java, Dagger, AWS Lambda, Smithy)

Designed and implemented the front-end website using React, Redux and TypeScript following best practices to achieve optimal performance and responsiveness in mobile and under poor connectivity. (TypeScript, React, Redux, API Gateway, AWS Lambda)
Designed the first version of a data processing platform to analyze and detect stuck shipments within the Amazon Fulfillment Network. (AWS Glue, Athena, ECS)
Supported multiple teams on high severity and low severity incidents, decreasing resolution time.
Developed a pipeline scanning tool to analyze Full CD best practices across 1,000+ pipelines, and drove its adoption to improve the Full CD posture of 30 pipelines.
Improved an internal tool for automatic dashboard generation to show configured alert thresholds.

experience.title: Systems Engineer
highlights: Implemented a fully-automated pipeline to provision VMs on VMware ESXi using Jenkins and Ansible.
Developed customized Ansible inventory plugin to get inventory information via the vSphere Automation SDK.
Developed a three-tiered Angular/Spring Boot Java application for accounting.
Developed a new service management facility built on ksh88.
